name: CN_TP_TRANSACTIONS_INT
description: Interface table for  CRM high volume import of incentive compensation  transactions.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Transaction Identifier

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: This is the SYSTASK_ID for a given Job in MKT_IMP_JOBS

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: INTERFACE_ROW_ID

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Errored out

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: ACTION_CODE

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE

columns.name: STAG_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Transaction Identifier in staging table.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the record is a transaction.

columns.name: CREDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the record is a credit.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for salesrep of the transaction

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the salesrep of the transaction

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_EMAIL
columns.description: Email address of the salesrep of the transaction

columns.name: CREDITED_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for salesrep who will get credit for this transaction

columns.name: CREDITED_PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the salesrep who will get credit for this transaction

columns.name: CREDITED_PARTICIPANT_EMAIL
columns.description: Email address of the salesrep who will get credit for this transaction

columns.name: SOURCE_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date transaction was processed in the source system

columns.name: CREDIT_DATE
columns.description: Date based on which crediting rule will be determined

columns.name: ROLLUP_DATE
columns.description: Date based on which rollup hierarchy will be determined

columns.name: TRANSACTION_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the period.

columns.name: CREDIT_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the period.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMT_SOURCE_CURR
columns.description: Transaction Amount in source currency

columns.name: CREDIT_AMT_SOURCE_CURR
columns.description: Credit Amount in source currency

columns.name: SOURCE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency Code in which the transaction amount is specified

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMT_FUNC_CURR
columns.description: Transaction Amount in Functional Currency

columns.name: CREDIT_AMT_FUNC_CURR
columns.description: Credit Amount in Functional Currency

columns.name: SOURCE_TO_FUNC_CURR_CNVRT
columns.description: Source to Function Currency conversion rate

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMT_HOME_CURR
columns.description: Transaction amount in home currency

columns.name: CREDIT_AMT_HOME_CURR
columns.description: Credit amount in home currency

columns.name: HOME_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Home currency code

columns.name: SOURCE_TO_HOME_CURR_CNVRT
columns.description: Source to home currency conversion rate

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMT_CALC_CURR
columns.description: Transaction Amount in calculation currency

columns.name: CREDIT_AMT_CALC_CURR
columns.description: Credit Amount in calculation currency

columns.name: CALC_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Calculation currency code

columns.name: SOURCE_TO_CALC_CURR_CNVRT
columns.description: Source to calculation currency conversion rate

columns.name: REVENUE_TYPE
columns.description: Possible values : Revenue, Non revenue, a custom revenue type

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Discount Percentage, exposed in UI

columns.name: MARGIN_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Margin Percentage, exposed in UI

columns.name: TRANSACTION_QTY
columns.description: Quantity of the unit sold in the transaction

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: In V1, possible value is only Base

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction Type, identifying the source of the transaction

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_CAT_ID
columns.description: Eligible Category, populated during classification

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_CAT_NAME
columns.description: Eligible category name

columns.name: OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the transaction

columns.name: CREDIT_OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: Object status of imported credits

columns.name: COLLECTION_STATUS
columns.description: Collection Status of the transaction

columns.name: CREDIT_COLLECTION_STATUS
columns.description: Collection Status of the credits.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STATUS
columns.description: Adjustment Status

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_COMMENTS
columns.description: Reason for adjustment

columns.name: PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Code to identify the phases required for the transaction; Points to a new table, which will contain a separate row for the processing_code, phase and a flag to indicate whether to skip the phase

columns.name: SOURCE_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of organization from which the transaction is imported

columns.name: SOURCE_BUSINESS_UNIT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the organization from which the transaction is imported

columns.description: User friendly unique identifier of the transaction

columns.description: Sales credit id of the source trx

columns.description: Unique identifier for customer

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for item

columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier for order

columns.name: BOOKED_DATE
columns.description: Date order gets booked

columns.name: INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier for invoice

columns.name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Invoice Date

columns.name: BILL_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of billing address

columns.name: SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifierr of shipping address

columns.description: Unique identifier of billing point of contact

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of shipping point of contact

columns.name: SALES_CHANNEL
columns.description: Sales Channel

columns.name: SPLIT_PCT
columns.description: Split Percentage

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of  Measure

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for adjustment

columns.name: CLSFN_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for classification rule

columns.name: CLSFN_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name for classification rule

columns.name: CREDIT_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for credit rule

columns.name: CREDIT_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the credit rule

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifying the role of the salesrep in the group

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the role of the salesrep in the group

columns.name: TERR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of territory

columns.name: TERR_NAME
columns.description: Territory Name

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Name of the country

columns.description: Name of the state

columns.description: Name of the City

columns.name: PROVINCE
columns.description: Name of the province

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal Code

columns.name: AREA_CODE
columns.description: Area Code

columns.name: CHANGED_TRX_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this is a new transaction or a modified one.

columns.name: HOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Transaction will not be considered for further processing if this flag is set to Y

columns.name: CREDIT_HOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Credit will not be considered for further processing if this flag is set to Y

columns.name: LOCK_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this transaction and its credits cannot be modified directly by the user.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Used to group transactions into batches

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the record is processed or not
